en.title: Stop your iPhone alarm → Grok Bot starts your daily briefing (webhook trigger)
en.summary: Stopping your iPhone alarm starts a Grok Bot daily briefing through a webhook, with no app to open and no prompt to type.
en.whyItWorks: A fixed-schedule briefing runs whether or not you're up. The author wanted Grok Bot to start the moment a real-world event happens, with no app opening or prompt typing.
workflowSteps: Ask Grok Bot to create a daily briefing routine triggered by a webhook instead of a schedule; copy the webhook URL and Authorization header.
iPhone Shortcuts → new Automation → Alarm → Is Stopped → choose your morning alarm. Toggle the automation on and notifications off.
Add action "Get Contents of URL", paste the Grok Bot webhook URL, set method to POST.
Add header Authorization = Bearer <value>. Request Body: JSON, add a Text field key=source, text=iphone-alarm.
Save, and disable "Ask Before Running" if shown.
en.promptTemplate: Routine ask: "Create a daily briefing routine triggered by a webhook instead of a schedule." Shortcut: Get Contents of URL · POST · header Authorization: Bearer <value> · JSON body {"source": "iphone-alarm"}.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Grok Bot webhook-triggered routine + iOS Shortcuts personal automation (Alarm → Is Stopped). Briefing contents depend on the connectors your routine uses; the post names none. Author's other trigger ideas: leave work → prepare tomorrow's priorities; connect to CarPlay → commute briefing; arrive home → evening household routine; tap an NFC tag → start a specific bot workflow.

setupSteps.title: Create a webhook-triggered daily briefing routine
setupSteps.detail: Ask Grok Bot to create a daily briefing routine triggered by a webhook instead of a schedule. Copy the webhook URL and Authorization header.

setupSteps.title: Automate Alarm → Is Stopped
setupSteps.detail: iPhone Shortcuts → new Automation → Alarm → Is Stopped → choose your morning alarm. Toggle the automation on and notifications off.

setupSteps.title: POST the webhook URL
setupSteps.detail: Add action "Get Contents of URL", paste the Grok Bot webhook URL, and set the method to POST.

setupSteps.title: Send Authorization and a JSON body
setupSteps.detail: Add header Authorization = Bearer <value> (the value Grok Bot gave you). Request Body: JSON, add a Text field key=source, text=iphone-alarm.

setupSteps.title: Save and turn off Ask Before Running
setupSteps.detail: Save, and disable "Ask Before Running" if shown. The briefing starts when the alarm is stopped. What the briefing contains depends on the connectors your routine uses; the post does not name them.

acceptanceChecklist: A daily briefing routine was created and is triggered by a webhook instead of a schedule.
The Shortcut automation is set to Alarm → Is Stopped for your morning alarm, with the automation on and notifications off.
The action is "Get Contents of URL", method POST, with header Authorization = Bearer <value>.
The JSON body includes a Text field source=iphone-alarm.
"Ask Before Running" is off, and the briefing starts when the alarm is stopped.

zh.title: 关掉 iPhone 闹钟 → Grok Bot 自动开始准备每日简报（Webhook 触发）
zh.summary: 关掉 iPhone 闹钟后，Webhook 会让 Grok Bot 开始准备每日简报，不用打开 App，也不用输入 Prompt。
zh.whyItWorks: 固定时间的简报不管你起没起床都会跑。作者希望现实中的事件一发生，Grok Bot 就开工，不用打开 App、不用输入 Prompt。
workflowSteps: 让 Grok Bot 创建一个由 Webhook（而不是定时）触发的每日简报 Routine，拿到 Webhook URL 和 Authorization 请求头。
iPhone 快捷指令 → 新建自动化 → 闹钟 → 停止时 → 选择早晨闹钟。开启该自动化，关闭通知。
添加操作「获取 URL 内容」，粘贴 Grok Bot Webhook URL，方法设为 POST。
添加请求头 Authorization = Bearer <value>。请求体选 JSON，添加文本字段：键 source，值 iphone-alarm。
保存；如出现「运行前询问」则关闭。
zh.promptTemplate: Routine 指令：「Create a daily briefing routine triggered by a webhook instead of a schedule.」快捷指令：获取 URL 内容 · POST · 请求头 Authorization: Bearer <value> · JSON 请求体 {"source": "iphone-alarm"}。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: Grok Bot Webhook 触发 Routine + iOS 快捷指令个人自动化（闹钟 → 停止时）。简报内容取决于你的 Routine 所用连接器（原帖未指明）。作者提到的其他触发点：下班离开公司 → 准备明日优先事项；连上 CarPlay → 通勤简报；到家 → 晚间家务 Routine；碰一下 NFC 标签 → 启动指定 Bot 工作流。

setupSteps.title: 创建由 Webhook 触发的每日简报 Routine
setupSteps.detail: 让 Grok Bot 创建一个由 Webhook（而不是定时）触发的每日简报 Routine，拿到 Webhook URL 和 Authorization 请求头。

setupSteps.title: 设置闹钟 → 停止时
setupSteps.detail: iPhone 快捷指令 → 新建自动化 → 闹钟 → 停止时 → 选择早晨闹钟。开启该自动化，关闭通知。

setupSteps.title: 用 POST 调用 Webhook URL
setupSteps.detail: 添加操作「获取 URL 内容」，粘贴 Grok Bot Webhook URL，方法设为 POST。

setupSteps.title: 带上 Authorization 和 JSON 请求体
setupSteps.detail: 添加请求头 Authorization = Bearer <value>（Grok Bot 提供的值）。请求体选 JSON，添加文本字段：键 source，值 iphone-alarm。

setupSteps.title: 保存并关闭「运行前询问」
setupSteps.detail: 保存；如出现「运行前询问」则关闭。闹钟停止时简报开始。简报内容取决于你的 Routine 所用连接器，原帖未指明。

acceptanceChecklist: 已创建由 Webhook（而不是定时）触发的每日简报 Routine。
快捷指令自动化设为闹钟 → 停止时，并选择了早晨闹钟；该自动化已开启，通知已关闭。
操作为「获取 URL 内容」，方法为 POST，请求头 Authorization 为 Bearer <value>。
JSON 请求体包含文本字段 source=iphone-alarm。
「运行前询问」已关闭，闹钟停止时简报开始。
